title: Restart a robot using the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen (robot ID + Restart button)
summary: Use the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen to restart a specific robot by entering/selecting its robot ID, clicking “Restart,” and then verifying the restarted robot appears positioned at the restart point / QR code cell.
when_to_use: When you need to restart a specific robot from the Robot Selection / Restart Robot interface and then confirm it returns to the restart point / QR code cell.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the restart from the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen and verify the restarted robot is displayed at the restart point / QR code cell.
safety_notes: If the robot does not restart or does not appear at the restart point / QR code cell after clicking “Restart,” stop and escalate (no additional recovery steps are provided in the source).
access_or_tools_needed: Robot ID entry field (source example includes “IBGGGE0000”)
On-screen visual confirmation area for the robot at the restart point / QR code cell

system_preconditions: You can access the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen.

visual_references.description: Robot Selection / Restart Robot slide showing robot ID entry, “Restart” action, and the note that the robot restarts at the restart point / QR code cell and is displayed after starting.

steps.title: Open the “Robot Selection / Restart Robot” screen
steps.purpose: Get to the interface where you can select a robot by ID and initiate the restart.
steps.instruction: Open the “Robot Selection / Restart Robot” screen.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen is open and ready for robot ID selection/entry and restart action.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the robot ID selection/entry area and the “Restart” button on the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen or cannot see the robot ID selection/entry area and “Restart” button.

actions.label: Open restart screen
actions.exact_action: Open the “Robot Selection / Restart Robot” screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Slide instructions reference the “Robot Selection / Restart Robot” interface and the steps to enter/select a robot ID and click “Restart.”

steps.title: Enter the corresponding robot ID (or select the robot)
steps.purpose: Select the specific robot that you want to restart.
steps.instruction: Enter the corresponding robot ID (example shown in the source: “IBGGGE0000”) or select the robot from the available selection.
steps.expected_result: The intended robot is selected/identified on the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen using its robot ID.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot ID you entered/selected matches the robot you intend to restart (robot selection is reflected in the screen’s robot selection area).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot enter/select the intended robot ID, or the wrong robot appears selected.

actions.label: Select robot by ID
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: OCR/instructions: “Enter the corresponding robot Id… select the robot.” Example robot ID shown: “IBGGGE0000.”

steps.title: Click “Restart”
steps.purpose: Initiate the restart for the selected robot.
steps.instruction: Click the “Restart” button on the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen.
steps.expected_result: The restart action is triggered for the selected robot.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking “Restart,” the system proceeds with restarting the robot (you can then observe the robot’s post-restart position/display).
steps.failure_condition: No restart occurs (robot does not restart) after clicking “Restart.”
stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot does not restart after clicking “Restart,” stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Slide instructions: “Click ‘Restart’… The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).”

steps.title: Wait for the robot to restart (restart point / QR code cell)
steps.purpose: Allow the robot to complete its restart so it can resume from the restart point / QR code cell.
steps.instruction: Wait for the robot to restart; the source indicates it will be at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
steps.expected_result: The robot has restarted and is positioned at the restart point / QR code cell.
steps.healthy_condition: The restarted robot is ready and appears at the restart point / QR code cell as part of the post-restart state.
steps.failure_condition: The robot does not appear at the restart point / QR code cell after restarting.

actions.label: Observe restart completion
actions.exact_action: Wait for the robot to restart.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot does not appear at the restart point / QR code cell after clicking “Restart,” stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: OCR/instructions: “The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).”

steps.title: Confirm the restarted robot is displayed on the screen
steps.purpose: Verify the restart succeeded by checking the robot’s on-screen display after starting.
steps.instruction: After starting, confirm the restarted robot that has been positioned is displayed on the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen (the source references a display area, though the exact label is unclear).
steps.expected_result: The restarted robot is displayed on the screen as positioned at the restart point / QR code cell.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot you restarted is visible on the screen in the post-restart position (restart point / QR code cell).
steps.failure_condition: The restarted robot is not displayed on the screen after starting, or it is not shown at the restart point / QR code cell.

actions.label: Verify post-restart display
actions.exact_action: Confirm the robot that has been positioned is displayed on the screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot does not restart or does not appear at the restart point / QR code cell after clicking Restart, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: OCR/instructions: “After starting, the robot… will be displayed…” and “The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).”

success_criteria: Restarted robot is shown positioned at the restart point / QR code cell.
Restarted robot is displayed on the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen after starting.
healthy_conditions: On the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen, the restarted robot appears in the restart point / QR code cell position.
failure_conditions: Robot does not restart after clicking “Restart.”
Robot does not appear at the restart point / QR code cell after restarting.
Restarted robot is not displayed on the screen after starting.
escalation_guidance: If the robot does not restart or does not appear at the restart point / QR code cell after clicking “Restart,” stop and escalate (the source does not provide further recovery steps).
